hero.title:
Financial Automation,
Effortless Precision.
hero.description: Mizani is an intelligent financial distribution system that automatically splits your income across various accounts (savings, investments, expenses) based on rules you define. Say goodbye to complex manual calculations.

howItWorks.title: How Mizani Works
howItWorks.description: Three simple steps to automate your financial life and focus on what truly matters.

step1.title: Connect and Set Ratios
step1.description: Connect your bank accounts with total security, and define your custom rules. How much do you want to save? How much to invest? Set the rules once.

step2.title: Automatic Distribution
step2.description: Once your salary or any income arrives, Mizani immediately distributes the funds across different accounts and funds according to your rules without your intervention.

step3.title: Track and Grow
step3.description: Monitor the growth of your savings and investments through a single simple and beautiful dashboard. Adjust rules anytime to suit your new goals.

pricing.title: Transparent Plans, Real Value
pricing.description: Choose the plan that suits your financial needs, with no hidden fees.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Mizani security and accounts.
faq.q1: Is my banking data safe with Mizani?
faq.a1: Yes, security is our top priority. We use bank-grade encryption (AES-256) and do not store your login data on our servers. Mizani has 'read and perform programmed transfers only' permissions and cannot withdraw funds to any third party.
faq.q3: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.q4: What happens if my salary or income changes?
